key_patterns: Model contract (confirmed): input float32 [N,3,224,224], RGB, /255 only (mean [0,0,0], std [1,1,1]), white(255) pad-to-square letterbox. Observer script_classifier._letterbox uses cv2.resize INTER_CUBIC; lipika's own fontrecog letterbox uses PIL Image.BICUBIC (this A-vs-C difference is the point of the eval). Labels (14 slots, index order): bengali, devanagari, gujarati, gurmukhi, kannada, latin, malayalam, other, odia, other, arabic, other, tamil, telugu — three 'other' slots (7,9,11) collapse to one. SampleObs/DocPrior/PageProbe are pydantic BaseModels in types.py; ProbeConfig is a dataclass with from_env reading IDP_PROBE_* vars via _env(). routing.decide_route is keyword-only. Handwriting was ALREADY torn out earlier; Phase 2 RE-ADDS it flag-gated — adding handwriting_prob=None (Optional) keeps all existing constructions/call sites valid, and decide_route with handwriting_prob=None must be byte-identical to today.
